title: Hardcopy guidebook
content: Tyler Curtis and Mariann Saether have completed a paperback guidebook that is now available for sale. In Chile it can be purchased from Ben May’s store Kayak Chile in Pucon or it can be purchased by contacting Tyler directly. When he is residing in Canada the contact phone is 613.582.3531. When in Norway or Chile best to get him via e-mail tyler@riverplay.ca or via website at http://www.whitewaterchile.com

title: History of First Descents
content:
The following information has been put together over many years. Much of the “early years” information came from John Foss who spent many years preparing to write a guidebook prior to his untimely death in July 1998. The list starts with rivers in the north and moves progressively southwards.

Some rivers are listed here without details as it is known they have been run but not by whom or when. As the info is confirmed it will be added and over time many of the river descriptions added to this site as well.

title: About authors
content:
This website was created by Kurt Casey and Fields Marshall.

Kurt Casey lives in Steamboat Springs, Colorado  and previously in Pucon in the 9th region of Southern Chile.

Kurt has started another website called a Kayakers Guide to Peru

Pablo Casey age 7 Rio Desague foto by Demshitz

Fields Marshall is a website developer and whitewater enthusiast who lives in Ashland Oregon and previously in Pucon, Chile.

Many of the posts were taken from the notes of John Foss. John was in process of writing a Chilean whitewater guide when he was pinned and killed on the first descent of Rio Huallabama in Peru in 1998. John’s posts are noted as posthumously.

Other contributors to this site are Jared Seiler, Ian and Evan Garcia, Robby Dastin, Mariann Saether,  and Nathan Sullivan

title: Dedication
content:
This web site has been produced in the memory of John Foss

John Foss Tampopata River July 1994

John was pinned and drowned on July 5th 1998 on the first descent of the Rio Huallabamba in Central Peru.

John was an adventurer, an amazing kayaker and most importantly a great friend. John was founder of Adventuras Andes and his 200 run guidebook “Chile Whitewater” was not quite completed before his passing.

We will all miss John and hope that his spirit lives on with the next generation of explorers and fun seekers.

title: Article/Photos Submission
content:
We are looking for new river descriptions, fotos, corrections, updates, etc. You are free to register as a user and submit using wordpress format. Please contact us for a user name and password.

As an alternative you can submit your text information in MS word file as an attachment and fotos in JPG format also as attachements to:

If you include a new river description please try to include the following:

1. East to understand directions to Put in and takeout
2. Class of river, approximate length, season, flow, etc
3. Brief description of river
4. Fotos at high resolution
5. Other interesting facts about area or river (e.g meaning of River name, local hot springs, local history, flora/fauna, etc)
6. Date the river was run
